Definition: to clap the hands (in token of compact, derision, grief, indignation, or punishment); by implication of satisfaction, to be enough; by implication of excess, to vomit
BiblicalUsage: 1) to clap, slap; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to slap, clap; 1a2) to slap, chastise; 1a3) to splash, throw up; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to clap
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
